claims.claim: For the six-arrow network A<->2A, B<->2B, A<->B with every rate constant equal to lambda>0, the no-flux PDE A_t=D_A Delta A+lambda(B-A^2), B_t=D_B Delta B+lambda(A-B^2) has a global positive mild solution (classical for t>0) from continuous strictly positive bounded data and satisfies Q_lambda(m0,t)<=A(x,t),B(x,t)<=Q_lambda(M0,t).
claims.scope: Bounded connected C2 domain, homogeneous Neumann data, D_A,D_B>0 including D_A != D_B; m0 and M0 are the initial joint infimum and supremum.
claims.evidence: Diagonal logistic solution plus cooperative parabolic comparison; upper comparison supplies global L-infinity bound and lower comparison supplies strict positivity.

claims.claim: The pointwise box [1/2,2]^2 is forward invariant and absorbs each strictly positive bounded initial profile by the explicit time T(m0,M0) in RESULT.txt; the same box and entry formula work for every mesh in the stated conservative Markov-generator class.
claims.scope: Mesh operators have nonnegative off-diagonal rates, zero row sums, and a positive invariant quadrature vector for the conservative no-flux interpretation; species generators and positive multipliers may differ and vary with mesh.
claims.evidence: The diagonal logistic profiles are exact constant mesh solutions; cooperative ODE comparison has the same bounds independently of node count and diffusion rates.

claims.claim: The reaction network is detailed-balanced, hence complex-balanced, at c*=(1,1), has full stoichiometric span, and is endotactic under the standard essential-source definition.
claims.scope: All six actual mass-action arrows have rate lambda and are paired with their reverse arrows.
claims.evidence: Fluxes at c* are lambda; complex A and B each have total inflow/outflow 2lambda, and 2A and 2B each have total inflow/outflow lambda. Reaction vectors include (1,0) and (0,1). Reverse-pair argument verifies endotacticity.

claims.claim: The relative entropy H(A,B)=integral sum_i (u_i log u_i-u_i+1) has the exact dissipation identity (3) in RESULT.txt under no-flux boundary data.
claims.evidence: Differentiate H, integrate diffusion terms by parts, and expand the three reversible reaction pairs.

claims.claim: The theorem proves mesh-uniform unequal-diffusion permanence for arbitrary complex-balanced or arbitrary endotactic networks.
claims.scope: General networks without a cooperative diagonal comparison curve are outside this result.
claims.evidence: No general extension or counterexample was produced in this leaf.

claims.claim: Deterministic PDE/mesh permanence implies stochastic recurrence, nonexplosion, an invariant stationary law, or all-time survival.
claims.scope: Stochastic properties are outside the model and proof.

costs.network_certificate: O(E*d) exact arithmetic; E=6 and d=2 here, hence constant size.
costs.finite_mesh_initial_extrema: O(|V_h|) comparisons, O(1) working memory if node values are supplied.
costs.continuum_initial_extrema: Certified m0,M0 are supplied assumptions; acquiring them from a function representation is not charged as free.
costs.uniformity: No mesh-size, spectral-gap, heat-kernel, or diffusion-size factor enters the absorber or entry formula.

falsifier: An exact positive classical PDE solution or a finite mesh trajectory satisfying the stated cooperative-conservative interface that exits the logistic sandwich in (1) or leaves [1/2,2]^2 after the formula (2) entry time.
